question: Does the H-940/H-2147/H-2148 branch identify local 110 as Parpola sign no. 41?
result: Correction: the checked local Lipi metadata has six rows containing local sign token 110, not three. H-940, H-2147, and H-2148 remain the current three-object Parpola sign-no.-41 branch, but H-2147 is now demoted to component-level visual pressure after raw recropping; it is not a clean single-sign panel witness. H-940 B is source-visible as local +110+ but remains visually split at current public quality. H-2148 is public_visual_route_count_mapped through Kenoyer 2005 Figure 14.1 and is the cleanest current branch witness. H-2100, H-2152, and Kanmer 4881.1 are outside 110 controls that block any population-level local 110 = Parpola sign no. 41 claim.

accepted_claims.raw_lipi_110_scope: Six rows contain local sign token 110 in the sign-string field: H-2148, H-2147, H-2100, H-2152, H-940, and Kanmer 4881.1.
accepted_claims.parpola_branch_scope: H-940, H-2147, and H-2148 are the active three-object Parpola sign-no.-41 branch in the checked project state.
accepted_claims.h940_source_visible_110: H-940 B is a source-visible local +110+ anchor.
accepted_claims.h2148_source_visible_110: H-2148 is source-visible at object and count-level mapping: the Figure 14.1 one-sign panel maps to local 481.2 +110+ by sign count.
accepted_claims.hypothesis_priority: local 110 <-> Parpola sign no. 41 remains a priority crosswalk target only after adding outside controls
accepted_claims.h2147_component_only: H-2147 is public object-visible, but current visual evidence is only component-level pressure, not clean single-sign-panel evidence.

not_accepted: local 110 appears only in H-940, H-2147, and H-2148
H-2148 side-label or Parpola sign-list evidence beyond count-level row mapping
H-2147 lower panel is a clean single-sign 110 witness
next_gate: Retest only after acquiring H-2147 Figure 27.14/source-side notes and a better H-940 B source panel; keep H-2148 as the cleanest count-mapped target; keep H-2100, H-2152, and Kanmer as outside controls.
